title: check:mail-dns proves the resolver works before it reads ENOTFOUND as a missing record
detail: ENOTFOUND was treated as an answer, so a resolver with no network reported seven red mail-DNS rows (no DMARC, no SPF, no MX) instead of exiting 2. A canary lookup (google.com MX) now runs first; if it fails the script says DNS is unreachable and exits 2. Expected lift: the gate stops crying wolf in sandboxes and CI without DNS, and a real regression stays visible.

verify.evidence: Probe passes on this branch; the script now exits 2 with no DNS.
